status: research-only software service ABI, not a frozen native ABI or deployed hardware capability

compute.src0: 255 for versioned external input/old/next read, or 0 for private-S scratch
compute.native0: action 0 opaque scratch, 1 read old/write next, 2 consumer receipt, 4 read next for consumer
compute.native1: receipt bit 1 or 2 for actions2/4, otherwise0

publish.semantics: idempotent atomic compare-and-publish of next handle, guarded by actual update/consumer ACK and accepted child terminals

control_parameters.immutable: host job scalar memory immutable; G_PARAM actual responses; CALL locks all registers, state adapter checks first five state words against declared parameter_ref; words5..7 seed control loops/branches and may be transformed in GPRs
control_parameters.handles: nonzero distinct uint32, model store has at most16 named handles; these are external state-store handles, not claimed R native context numbers

state_policy.publication_linearization: provider atomic write, before response delivery; ACK loss means COMMIT_UNKNOWN, never claim old state preserved
state_policy.journal: transaction_id plus old/next/generation; persistent across modeled cohort reset; query resolves committed outcome; no new ISA opcode
state_policy.old_release: only after publication ACK/query and all consumers finished; pending failures preserve old until a possibly already committed publication is resolved

native_boundary: N/E/G/T/R mathematical operations and conversion/rounding/saturation are external services. IDs above denote candidate adapter operations, not actual native command values. Real adapters, parameter sideband and provider reset/CDC remain to implement; existing P RTL rejects this ABI. No physical/Block/model-quality qualification.
